world_rationale: All 116 recipes are covered: 57 unchanged baseline recipes inherit exact previously checked evidence, and all 59 additions received independent live source checks. All 36 added concept descriptions were read and their culinary uses checked; dairy chemistry, honey origin, cinnamon bark and crumb-versus-pesmet distinctions received specific source checks. Mucenici now accurately distinguishes the baked Moldovan and boiled Muntenian forms. Cooking processes and omitted ingredients are explicit or framed as simplified culinary associations. There are 111 concepts, including 58 crafted results and 53 supplied concepts (8 starters plus45 pantry supplies), so the catalog does not imply111 distinct crafts. All new supplies have uses, and complete closure and19 goals are reachable without changing recipes by goal. Existing57 recipes,75 concept snapshots/descriptions, starters and prior supply tiers are byte-equivalent to the baseline candidate. The new pantry rewards remain supplied ingredients, not crafted discoveries. Some pairs have other real-world interpretations; factual acceptance is not a uniqueness or human-playtest finding. Source snapshots/provenance remain intact and the world adds no live AI inference.
